Publish viewport chunks and search shards, then reconcile source, emitted, skipped, and joined counts.
Run county QC and keep visible activation disabled until every individual gate passes.

joinKeys.primaryParcelAccount: GlobalID refresh-local source-feature identity; propID/PROP_ID retained as secondary business identifiers with documented nulls and duplicates; never cross-refresh join on GlobalID
joinKeys.appraisal: direct fields on the same CCAD parcel feature: currValLand, currValImprv, currValMarket, currValAppraised
joinKeys.land: direct fields on the same CCAD parcel feature: landSizeAcres and landSizeSqft
joinKeys.secondaryParcelGisId: geoID candidate; duplicate groups exist and must be resolved before production
joinKeys.blockLabels: direct fields on the same CCAD parcel feature: legalAbsSubBlock, legalAbsSubName, and mapID
joinKeys.dimensions: direct fields on the same CCAD parcel feature: landSizeSqft, landSizeAcres, and Shape__Length
joinKeys.permits: exact official CCAD permit propID -> unique current CCAD propertyId -> current refresh GlobalID; preserve unmatched and ambiguous outcomes
joinKeys.zoning: CCAD accountNum/countyParcelId -> parcel liveGeometry centroid -> official municipal zoning polygon; parcel city-matched municipal source precedence
joinKeys.floodplain: parcel liveGeometry centroid -> FEMA NFHL Flood Hazard Zones polygon -> county parcel/account identifiers
joinKeys.developmentSignals: exact official CCAD permit propID -> unique current CCAD propertyId -> current-refresh GlobalID; unmatched, ambiguous, and future-dated records remain separately counted
joinKeys.migrationDemand: aggregate ACS/IRS county geography joined by Collin County FIPS 48085; context only, not an individual parcel or person fact
